scope: Puerto Williams urban capacity: electricity, fuels, telecommunications and banking
source_policy: Prefer Chilean institutional/regulatory sources; use operator first-party for service existence; keep availability and continuity dynamic.

claims.claim: Puerto Williams is served by EDELMAG as one of the isolated/medium electrical systems of Magallanes.
claims.notes: System existence is stable; outages and restoration times are dynamic and must be checked live.

claims.claim: EDELMAG publishes a customer office in Puerto Williams at Presidente Ibañez 130.
SEC documented a Copec service station in Puerto Williams and stated in 2023 that it was the only service station in the commune.
claims.notes: Do not infer 2026 stock, opening hours or uniqueness from a 2023 inspection. Fuel availability must be revalidated for travel advice.

claims.claim: SEC documented a Gasco LPG filling plant in Puerto Williams in 2023.
claims.notes: Existence was regulator-verified in 2023; current operating status and stock require recheck.

claims.claim: Puerto Williams is a terminal/access point of the Fibra Óptica Austral trunk infrastructure connecting the far south to the national network.
claims.notes: Infrastructure existence is stable; resilience, outages and retail-provider availability are dynamic.

claims.claim: SUBTEL and MTT inaugurated 5G connectivity in Puerto Williams in 2022 through Entel infrastructure.
claims.notes: Do not infer universal present-day coverage, indoor signal quality, all-operator 5G, or uninterrupted service.

claims.claim: A Chilean government-commissioned feasibility study notes that Puerto Williams has moved from legacy GEO-satellite dependence to FOA-backed 4G/5G and FTTH, while retaining resilience risk from reliance on a single physical route.
claims.notes: Useful for infrastructure/resilience analysis; not a substitute for a live coverage map or ISP availability lookup.

claims.claim: BancoEstado reports that it opened a branch in Puerto Williams during 2025 as part of its territorial coverage strategy.
claims.notes: Branch existence can be indexed; opening hours, cash availability, ATM status and specific services must be checked dynamically.

retrieval_rules.electricity: Embed system/operator identity, but route outage/restoration questions to live EDELMAG status channels.
retrieval_rules.fuel: Do not promise stock or opening hours from static sources; verify current service before travel advice.
retrieval_rules.telecommunications: Embed FOA and 5G infrastructure context; current operator coverage and outage state are dynamic.
retrieval_rules.banking: Embed BancoEstado branch presence; ATM cash/uptime and branch hours are dynamic.
retrieval_rules.core_inference_barrier: Infrastructure exists != service available now != stock/capacity available now != guaranteed continuity.
